tagline: QUALITY COATED STEEL FOR A MORE SUSTAINABLE FUTURE.
eyebrow: Metal roofing, light steel & smart building solutions

highlights.title: Since 1994
highlights.body: Tatalogam grew from a mission to replace easily corroded roofing with higher-quality coated metal products.

highlights.title: Broad product system
highlights.body: Its range spans light steel, metal tiles, floor decks, metal roofing, accessories and large-span building structures.

highlights.title: Standards & patents
highlights.body: The company highlights ISO 9001, relevant ASTM/AISC standards and patented metal-roofing technologies.

highlights.title: Sustainability focus
highlights.body: Tatalogam positions its products around sustainable materials, energy-efficient manufacturing and long service life.
